name: MariaDB VDB Provider
description: This enables the use of MariaDB Vector as a VDB in the AI module.
project_description: Native vector search for Drupal using MariaDB — no external services required. This module registers a 'MariaDB vector DB' provider (plugin id 'mariadb') for the Drupal AI module and its AI Search submodule, using MariaDB's native VECTOR data type and VECTOR indexes (available in MariaDB 11.7+, 11.8 LTS recommended). Because MariaDB is a drop-in replacement for MySQL and is commonly Drupal's primary database, embeddings can be stored and queried in the same database with full transactional support and no additional infrastructure. By default it reuses Drupal's active database connection; a separate MariaDB instance can be pointed to via a settings.php config override. It supports Euclidean and cosine distance metrics via MariaDB's modified HNSW index, integrates with Search API, ships Drush test commands for OpenAI rate-limit diagnostics, and throttles embedding API calls during indexing. Requires PHP 8.1+ and the mysqli extension.
